name: cache-countdown
description: Counts down to the prompt cache going cold, writes a handoff while you are away, and when the cache is cold offers to resume from the handoff or send with full context.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache stays warm after a request. auto uses what the engine reports or what this mod learned from past cache hits and misses, else 1h.

warnSeconds.title: Warn this many seconds before it goes cold
warnSeconds.description: When the countdown band, toast and sound appear.

askWhenCold.title: Ask before sending into a cold cache
askWhenCold.description: On the first prompt after the cache went cold, ask whether to resume from a handoff or send with full context.

whenAway.title: When you are away
whenAway.description: handoff: a minute before the cache goes cold, if you have not typed for a while, write a handoff (one request over the still-warm cache) so you can resume from it later. off: only warn.

awaySeconds.title: Away after this many seconds without typing
awaySeconds.description: How long without typing in the prompt box counts as away.

sound.title: Play a sound on warning and on going cold
sound.description: A short chime when the warning starts and another when the cache goes cold (macOS plays it).
